homepage.body:
Sidra Chain
HelpOpens in a new tab

A verified-human financial network

One verified human. One account.

Sidra is a verified-human financial network — claim daily rewards, hold a real ledger balance, and settle on a self-hosted chain. No seed phrases. No silent failures.

Get startedI already have an account

Proof of personhood

Passive liveness + KYCPort verification. One human, one account — sybil-resistant by design.

A real ledger

Double-entry balances are the source of truth. Settlement on a self-hosted EVM chain — your balance is never a silent zero.

Smart-account wallet

ERC-4337 accounts: no seed phrase, gasless transactions, social recovery via guardians.

Tokenized assets

Permissioned real-world assets on the L3 layer, with on-chain identity and compliance built in.

© 2026 Sidra ChainSelf-hosted · Open-source · Verified-human
